title: Real slow motion + Pawn lift glow when switching (0.9.169)
intro: Release the pawn, Reset Scripts. Ideally near an enemy or with pawns moving, so the slow motion shows. Press End to start.

steps.text: Switch to pawns and back a few times. Everything should visibly slow down during the camera move, and the new character should glow green/blue until the camera settles.
Done. Did the action slow down? Did the glow last through the move?
